evidence.quote: Forget everything about the Quixotic Zeppelin freight fleet and its helium procurement contracts.

observations.why: Directive issued in the present moment targeting specific named artifacts (fleet, contracts) and demanding their removal — an irrealis command to alter knowledge state.

evidence.quote: Remove all knowledge of zeppelin routes.

observations.why: Present-tense directive demanding erasure of a category of knowledge (routes in general), irrealis in modality and abstract in construal.
